_comment: The ayat of the example clips OUTSIDE the lessons (content/library.json `clips`: a parts diagram's bentuk dasar, a Harakat sign's word), exactly as the pinned files have them: `tanzil` = the Tanzil Uthmani line, `segments` and `stats` = the quran-align Alafasy_128kbps entry. pipeline/cache is git-ignored, so without this file CI could not tell a shifted timing or a wrong word in these clips (review 2026-10-12). Written by build_library.py (clips.fixture_from); validate_clips.py checks it against the pinned files when the cache is present, and the clips against it in every run. Never edit by hand.

2:5.tanzil: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

5:23.tanzil: قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَٰلِبُونَ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

26:24.tanzil: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

55:78.tanzil: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
